title: The 180° shutter rule
summary: The shutter speed that makes video motion look natural.

blocks.text: For natural-looking motion, set the shutter to about **double the frame rate**: 1/(2 × fps).

items: Much faster shutter: crisp but choppy, stuttering motion.
In bright sun the fixed shutter overexposes. Use an **ND filter** (a variable ND is easiest) instead of speeding up the shutter.
Lock ISO, white balance and exposure so the image doesn't pulse as you pan.
Shooting slow motion? Base the shutter on the recording frame rate, not the playback rate.
